$comment: The biped family's clip library (spec 139). Lives beside the skeleton rather than inside a member's folder, because it belongs to the family and not to whichever body happened to be generated first -- while it sat in pig_a_pose_full/ the second member reached sideways for it, and unit-assets.ts resolved those paths against the wrong directory for as long as the two were the same one. Generated by Studio export from job 2e2671c3-933a-417d-8427-97b7c627e0c9, except for `slash`, which was authored rather than retargeted (specs 139/143): the retarget's own swing is written for a reach and a commitment this game does not have, and melee.slash's 500ms wind-up would need it dragged past the maxTimeScale bound to fit. Its source is `src/units/pig-strike.ts`; regenerate the bytes with `npx tsx scripts/make-pig-strike.ts`. `shoot` is authored for the same reason and by the same route (spec 164) -- the retarget sold no bow draw at all, and `ranged.shot`'s 800ms wind-up is the beat it has to land on. Its source is `src/units/pig-shot.ts` and `npx tsx scripts/make-pig-shot.ts` writes it. `cast` is the third and the first that belongs to more than one ability (spec 231): seven spells are drawn with it, and because their wind-ups run from 0.5s to 1.4s its 850ms release is rebased per cast by `unit-driver.ts`'s `clipStretch` rather than being any one ability's number. Its source is `src/units/pig-cast.ts` and `npx tsx scripts/make-pig-cast.ts` writes it.
